import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# File paths
ref_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_141\external_Amazon_Jan-Jun_sales_data_simulation_res.xlsx"
pred_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\runs\aida-ctrl\work\FG_141\external_Amazon_Jan-Jun_sales_data_simulation.xlsx"

# Read both files
ref_df = pd.read_excel(ref_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')
pred_df = pd.read_excel(pred_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')

# Sample indices: head, tail, middle, random
n_rows = len(ref_df)
sample_size = min(30, n_rows // 10)  # 30 or 10% of data

head_idx = list(range(min(sample_size, n_rows)))
tail_idx = list(range(max(0, n_rows - sample_size), n_rows))
middle_idx = list(range(n_rows // 2 - sample_size // 2, n_rows // 2 + sample_size // 2))

# Random sample
np.random.seed(42)
random_idx = np.random.choice(n_rows, size=min(sample_size, n_rows), replace=False).tolist()

# Combine all indices
all_sample_idx = sorted(set(head_idx + tail_idx + middle_idx + random_idx))

print(f"Total rows: {n_rows}")
print(f"Sample size: {len(all_sample_idx)} rows")

# Compare sampled rows
ref_sample = ref_df.iloc[all_sample_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
pred_sample = pred_df.iloc[all_sample_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

# Check if they're equal
are_equal = ref_sample.equals(pred_sample)
print(f"\nSampled data equals: {are_equal}")

if not are_equal:
    # Check for near-equality with tolerance for floats
    diff_count = 0
    for col in ref_sample.columns:
        if ref_sample[col].dtype in [np.float64, np.float32]:
            # Numeric comparison with tolerance
            if not np.allclose(ref_sample[col], pred_sample[col], rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6, equal_nan=True):
                diff_count += 1
                print(f"Column '{col}' differs (numeric)")
        else:
            # Exact comparison
            if not ref_sample[col].equals(pred_sample[col]):
                diff_count += 1
                print(f"Column '{col}' differs")
                # Show first difference
                diff_mask = ref_sample[col] != pred_sample[col]
                if diff_mask.any():
                    first_diff_idx = diff_mask.idxmax()
                    print(f"  First diff at row {first_diff_idx}: ref='{ref_sample[col].iloc[first_diff_idx]}' vs pred='{pred_sample[col].iloc[first_diff_idx]}'")
    
    print(f"\nTotal columns with differences: {diff_count}")
else:
    print("✓ All sampled rows match perfectly!")
